class pyorps.graph.api.cython_api.CythonAPI(raster_data, steps, ignore_max=False)[source]¶

Bases: GraphAPI

Graph API implementation that directly uses Cython algorithms on raster data.

Initialize the base graph API with raster data and neighborhood steps.

Parameters:

  • raster_data – 2D numpy array representing the raster costs

  • steps – Array defining the neighborhood connections

  • ignore_max – Ignore edges whose weights are greater or equal to the maximum

  • data (value in the raster)

shortest_path(source_indices, target_indices, algorithm='dijkstra', **kwargs)[source]¶

Find shortest/least-cost path(s) using Cython implementations.

Parameters:

  • source_indices (int | List[int] | ndarray) – Source node indices

  • target_indices (int | List[int] | ndarray) – Target node indices

  • algorithm (str) – Algorithm name (“dijkstra” or “delta-stepping”)

  • **kwargs – Additional parameters: - pairwise: bool - compute paths pairwise (for multiple sources/targets) - delta: float - bucket width for delta-stepping (default 50) - use_astar: bool - enable A* heuristic for delta-stepping (default True) - num_threads: int - number of threads for delta-stepping (0=auto) - min_cell_cost: float - minimum cell cost for A* heuristic

Returns:

List of path indices or list of lists for multiple paths

Return type:

List[int] | List[List[int]]
